court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Additional District Judge, Puducherry at Karaikal - M.O.P.No.22 of 2005
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 1984. The husband filed for divorce citing cruelty and desertion. The wife refused to live with the husband after 1986 and left him with their children. The trial court granted a decree for dissolution of marriage.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse who refuses to live with the other and takes their children away is considered deserted.
legal_principles.held: The trial Court found that the appellant/wife was living with the respondent/husband till the year 1986. She lived with the respondent/husband only for about 3 years and thereafter, she refused to live with the respondent/husband.

legal_principles.principle: A party's refusal to live with the other and taking children away can be considered desertion.
legal_principles.held: The trial Court arrived a conclusion that the appellant/wife deserted the respondent/husband and therefore, he is entitled for the relief of dissolution of marriage.

outcome.final_order: The appeal was allowed, and the decree for dissolution of marriage was set aside.
